race.comment: ATWORTHY ROCKER (2) enjoys a class drop off the Regional Championships final. Had finished third in a heat of that series here prior, adding to a string of wins or placings. Nicely placed and is well drawn so can bounce back. ATOMIK GO ANNA (1) has come from the back row in recent outings at Shepparton and has been far from disgraced. Much better served by the ace draw and is has won at this circuit and distance before. CEEBEE (3) should find this easier than the last attempt in the city and draws well. PIRANI PRINCESS (7) draws wide but made it back-to-back placings when third from this barrier last start. CORZAN DRAMA (6) disappointed last time but was back from a let-up there and had been quite consistent prior so may improve.
